summary.intent: Execute Phase 25 (desktop-enhancements) via GSD wave-based orchestration, implementing TEE file enrollment, auto-updater integration, and CI desktop build workflow for a Tauri/Rust desktop app.
summary.outcome: All 3 plans completed successfully. TEE IPNS key wrapping, Tauri auto-updater, and GitHub Actions CI workflow were implemented. Ed25519 signing keypair was generated, GitHub secrets were set, and tauri.conf.json was updated with the real public key.

repo: Phase 25 is on branch `feat/phase-25-desktop-enhancements` — branching strategy is 'phase' level
Desktop app lives at `apps/desktop/src-tauri/` with a `tauri.conf.json` config file
FUSE mount's `publish_file_metadata` handles both Unix (`fuse` feature) and Windows (`winfsp` feature) codepaths
TEE IPNS key wrapping encrypts IPNS private keys with the TEE public key on first publish via the FUSE mount
Tauri updater uses GitHub Releases as the update endpoint with Ed25519 signing
The Ed25519 public key placeholder in tauri.conf.json was `REPLACE_WITH_ED25519_PUBLIC_KEY`

code.finding: Contains Ed25519 public key for updater bundle signature verification — was placeholder, now set to real key after keypair generation

CI workflow builds cross-platform bundles: macOS ARM64 + Intel, Linux, Windows. Triggered on Release Please publish events. Uploads updater-compatible artifacts with Ed25519 sigs and latest.json manifest
New module: launch update check with 5s delay, plus manual check handler
Tauri updater plugin registered here; 'Check for Updates...' added to system tray menu

workflow: GSD plan 25-03 was marked `autonomous: false` due to the Ed25519 key setup checkpoint — but the checkpoint was fully automatable (keygen, GitHub secrets, config update)
Tauri keypair generation via `npx @tauri-apps/cli signer generate -w <path>` prompts for a password interactively — required workarounds (expect, piped stdin, double-entry) to automate
GitHub secrets can be set via `gh secret set` CLI; network timeouts are possible and a simple retry resolves them
Worker2 worktree (`cipher-box-worker2`) was used for plan execution — subagents operate in separate worktrees

friction: Ed25519 keypair generation is interactive (TTY password prompt) — required multiple bash invocation attempts (expect, piped stdin) before finding a working automation approach
GitHub secret API call hit a network timeout on first attempt, requiring a retry
Plan 25-03 was marked `autonomous: false` and interrupted execution for a checkpoint that turned out to be fully automatable
open_items: Without the Ed25519 signing keys configured, CI builds would produce bundles without `.sig` files — now resolved, but CI must be tested on next release to confirm signature verification works end-to-end
The `tauri.conf.json` update with the real public key needs to be verified against actual update bundle verification in a real release flow
Temp password file cleanup was performed — confirm no secrets were left in shell history or temp files
